name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_query_status
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::QueryStatus reads and clears the status token edit, dispatches a token/server status query when a token is present, and otherwise shows the localized missing-token error message.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e550 validates token buffer size 20 with GetWindowTextA max count 19, token edit clearing, strtok on a space delimiter, token copy into WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConnectContext::m_requestText, server buffer size 80 with max count 79, server edit clearing, WOL provider QueryStatusWithTokenAndServer through vtable offset 0x64, and the no-token MessageBoxA branch using zLoc ids 0x3003 and 0x303d with MB_ICONHAND.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_query_status_smoke patches GetWindowTextA, SetWindowTextA, zLoc::GetMessageString, and CWnd::MessageBoxA, and verifies the provider path token truncation at the first delimiter, server text handoff, return propagation, edit clearing, no-token localized message-box branch, message ids, icon type, and suppressed provider call.
